issues.problem: Context 3 (在……中, accent changing) fits 耳濡目染 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it to stress that the change went unnoticed (变化是潜移默化的，连他自己都没有察觉).

issues.problem: The story implied the Laozi text uses the idiom's wording, but it reads 深根固柢.
issues.action: Added that the original has the halves in a different order and spelling.

issues.problem: Context 5 (停电是……的事) is the typical slot for 司空见惯 and fits it equally well.
issues.action: Rewrote it as a person getting used to power cuts over half a year.

issues.problem: 在爷爷的耳濡目染下 makes the grandfather the one exposed, a common but criticised usage; context 4 (是不是家里耳濡目染) was ungrammatical.
issues.action: Rewrote context 2 (她耳濡目染，也成了小戏迷) and context 4 (是在家里耳濡目染的吧), and removed the 在……的耳濡目染下 pattern from the how line.

issues.problem: Context 4 fits 无能为力 just as well; the story did not note that the ode reads 爱莫助之.
issues.action: Rewrote context 4 to stress sympathy and wanting to help; added that the ode's wording differs slightly.

issues.problem: Context 3 (我很想帮忙……有点) fits 爱莫能助; the English of context 1 was awkward.
issues.action: Replaced context 3 with a man whose body can't yet keep up after illness; smoothed the English of context 1.
